existingNative50mpPng.scope: Actual import, WASM tone edit, save/reopen/full native PNG decode; existing native SVG mask and embedded-PNG regressions also pass.

designAndLimits: Unfiltered smart instances expand through the shared validated native resolver into supported editable vector/raster/text contents. Generated master-canvas clips use editable rectangular vector masks in this private SVG view; native callers retain existing selection clips.

Enabled smart filters keep a native-rendered leaf. Raw content/filter masks render through the existing master-plane pipeline into a document-plane PNG over expanded shadow support. Outer masks/styles/fill/layer opacity/blend remain separate. Unlinked filter masks are translated during document-plane rebasing.

Shared master/component identity is not preserved in SVG, and filtered inner contents/filters/filter-mask geometry/off-support pixels are explicitly baked/lost. Ordinary paint/adjustments and Blend If remain omitted outside native-rendered content. Projects retain original masters, operations and sources.

One dependency capture includes reachable visible native-filter raster, clone, patch, bitmap-mask and filter-mask sources; filtered text font readiness/lifetime shares the existing SVG guard. Unused masters are not prepared, but complete registry validation and logical expansion budgets still apply.

Source/filter-mask replacement, font changes, cancellation and replacement during final encoding reject without partial output; captured native surfaces release. A later independent master replacement cannot rewrite the captured export and retains exactly one undo entry.

Shared native full-frame raster-master optimization now preserves source erasures. An independently expected transparent sample verifies the erased master in real SVG output, alongside unit preservation/ownership invariants and broad native smart rendering regressions.

Fourteen of nineteen appearance fixtures are byte-exact for alpha/premultiplied RGB. Inner master styles reach one byte; three mask/style filtered cases reach two alpha levels and at most 2.1960784313725554 premultiplied values. The unfiltered affine shape has larger Canvas/SVG antialiasing differences, measured separately with independent geometry.

Affine analytic parallelogram oracle uses corners [33.6,27], [93.6,42], [99.2,70], [39.2,55], area1596 and centroid[66.4,48.5]. Decoded SVG area1596.521568627451 and centroid[66.39564813700373,48.497457708302115], zero interior/exterior errors beyond a1.5px edge band; native comparison max alpha30/premult14.6 and mean alpha0.042291666666666665. No universal pixel identity is claimed.

50 MP evidence proves one native10000x5000 embedded-PNG decode shared by two smart instances after actual save/reopen, nine source-coordinate samples including native strip boundaries/opaque content/distant half-alpha/transparent edge, and unchanged original compressed bytes/model/revision. It does not establish full50MP composite SVG raster decode or peak memory.

Linked-image masters use verified stored local snapshots without watching or refreshing files. Source-file metadata is not copied into embedded PNGs. Complete unmodified raster pixels and editable text can retain masked/off-canvas content; SVG is not redaction.

Existing4096-node/64-depth logical component work budgets apply, including retained filtered descendants. No arbitrary MP/import cap or full-document host RGBA/canvas allocation is introduced. Original decoding, compressed/base64 output, native tile/filter buffers and viewer allocations still consume memory.

No public constructor/mutation API, schema/project/workspace version, REST renderer/browser synchronization, script/plugin file/font-byte/download privilege, paid service, cloud upload or source-byte mutation.

Remaining SVG shared symbols/master identity, ordinary paint/adjustments/Blend If, import/round-trip, wider formats/viewers/precision/memory/performance gates and the full roadmap remain incomplete. No input-to-photon/p95/long-task/peak-memory/device-independent speed guarantee is inferred from these tests.
